scope: One fixed read-system-facts pre-effect consumption gate over an exact A4 handoff, exact A1 executor identity, and fresh retained A6 currentness evidence. The slice persists one signed hash-addressed consumed record and still performs no target effect.
core_invariant: Fresh identity/currentness evidence and a signed handoff are still not an effect. Before any later read-system-facts adapter may run, the exact handoff must have a durable one-time consumed record. A restart, replay, conflicting writer, stale currentness input, identity substitution, or ambiguous persisted state must never restore spendable work.

decouple executor currentness from handoff identity
controls: credential digest must equal A4 intended_executor_identity_digest
A6 active credential digest must equal the exact executor credential
hard maximum freshness inherited from A6

risks: change consumption id to obtain another spend
controls: storage key excludes caller consumption id
exclusive create of one hash-derived record path
any existing or ambiguous record blocks a new consume

risks: tamper with semantic claims after signing
controls: store public-key digest bound into statement

risks: treat consumed record as effect proof
claim production persistence or media durability

known_nonclaims: This record does not authorize or execute read-system-facts.
This slice does not provide Linux containment or an effect-specific executor receipt.
This slice does not prove global revocation/currentness.
This slice does not provide distributed consensus, replicated persistence, hardware monotonic storage, or media-survival guarantees.
The caller chooses the dedicated state root; the module only constrains the derived child path beneath that root.
A separately retained exact record digest is required to detect later local deletion/rollback after restart.
This slice does not alter Gateway, Hypervisor, Sandbox, Grid routes, policy, capability registry, MCP/A2A transport, deployment, or production authority.
